preregistered_threshold.definition: Percent reduction in over-drainage events (CSF drainage > 20 mL/hr sustained > 30 seconds during apnea episode or within 60 seconds post-apnea) for M5_REFINED vs VIEshunt-style controller, in simulated patient population with documented sleep apnea (AHI 5-30) and venous pressure elevation 5-15 mmHg during apnea
preregistered_threshold.anti_inflation_compliance: Threshold fixed BEFORE simulation parameters explored.
preregistered_threshold.pass_condition: M5_REFINED over-drainage event reduction >= 30% AND under-drainage not increased by more than 10%

vieshunt_style.description: PI controller tracking population ICP reference (12 mmHg supine). 30-second averaging window. Pump max 8 mL/min. NO venous pressure compensation. NO sleep apnea detection.

m5_refined.description: PI controller tracking PATIENT-SPECIFIC ICP reference + venous pressure compensation (drainage reduced 1:0.3 with venous elevation) + apnea hold (drainage matched to CSF production during detected apnea).

honest_negative_finding.simplification_1_physiology: ICP B-wave modeled as 3x amplification of venous elevation capped at 50 mmHg. Real B-wave morphology is more complex.
honest_negative_finding.simplification_2_apnea_detection: M5_REFINED controller assumed PERFECT apnea detection (ground truth flag). Real apnea detection from SpO2/HRV/IMU has 80-95% sensitivity. This INFLATES M5_REFINED's apparent performance.
honest_negative_finding.simplification_3_venous_measurement: M5_REFINED controller assumed PERFECT real-time venous pressure measurement. Real sensor has noise, drift, biofouling. INFLATES M5_REFINED's apparent performance.
honest_negative_finding.simplification_4_single_night: Simulation runs single 8h sleep per patient. Real calibration requires multiple nights. Inter-night variability not modeled.
honest_negative_finding.simplification_5_patient_specific_refere: Patient-specific reference assumed known. Real calibration requires 24-72h. Calibration transient not modeled.
honest_negative_finding.simplification_6_patient_heterogeneity: Patient population generated with uniform distributions. Real iNPH population has correlated AHI/BMI/age/venous anatomy. Subpopulation effects not explored.
honest_negative_finding.interpretation_caveat: Primary result INFLATED by idealized detection and measurement. Conservative interpretation: real-world benefit may be 40-70% of simulated. Even at 50% retention (15-25% reduction), M5_REFINED may still meet threshold in severe-OSA subpopulation. V3 simulation MUST include detection noise, sensor drift, calibration transient, and patient heterogeneity.
